======================================================
 Kundan Kumar Yadav @ Kundan Kumar, S/o Rakesh Yadav, R/o Village-  Gogoal, P.S.- Singhwara, District- Darbhanga  ... ... Petitioner/
 Versus  The State of Bihar  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Girish Chandra Jha, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Pawan Kumar Chaurasia, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 3 08-05-2025 Heard Mr. Girish Chandra Jha, learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner and Mr.
Pawan Kumar Chaurasia, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Singhwara P.S. Case No. 130 of 2024,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366A, 376, 372, 420, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Allegedly the petitioner took away the informants daughter for the illicit purpose and to sell her.
The accused persons had also recorded some obscene video of her daughter and by giving threatening and pressurizing her, snatched Rs. 90,000/- and other valuables.
When the daughter of the informant anyhow fled away from the clutches of the accused persons, she informed the informant, then relative of the informant went there and saved her.

4. Learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.88187 of 2024(3)
dt.08-05-2025 petitioner contended that the occurrence took place on 02.11.2023 whereas, the present FIR came to be lodged on 04.01.2024.

In fact, no such type of occurrence took place as narrated in the FIR and the parties were in love with each other, however, later on when the pressure was mounted by the family member, the victim has given a tutored version.
From the FIR it is evident that the parties are major and, in fact, they were the consenting parties.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned Advocate for the State opposed the pre-arrest bail application and submits that there is a specific allegation against the petitioner of kidnapping and causing rape upon her.

6. Having considered the submissions advanced by learned Advocate for the parties and after going through the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
wherein she has made a specific allegation against the petitioner of causing rape upon her on threat,
this Court is not acceded to the prayer of anticipatory bail, accordingly the anticipatory bail application stands rejected.

(Harish Kumar, J) supratim/-
